title: Interest
coreMove: Convert vague passion hunting into patient sampling, feedback, and repeated return.
sourcePressure: Explain that durable passion usually begins as curiosity that is developed, not a lightning strike.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Telling readers to quit everything and follow a perfect passion immediately.

sourceAnchors.name: Marc Vetri
sourceAnchors.detail: The chef originally wanted to be a musician before cooking became the durable interest he developed.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Vetri’s path makes passion look less like discovery and more like tending a flame that first appeared somewhere else.

sourceAnchors.name: Julia Child
sourceAnchors.detail: She discovered French food in adulthood and then explored cooking over years rather than receiving a finished calling all at once.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Julia Child’s fish was not the whole career; it was the first door into years of exploration.

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: at least 4 distinct opening devices across the 6 examples, drawn from: timestamp+name+action, dialogue first line, sensory detail first, second-person You direct address, retrospective It took her three weeks to see, question-as-hook, environmental detail before any human
exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: C8 catches Cartesian repetition of phrases but not the deeper template of 'timestamp + named protagonist + prop + decision' that makes 6 examples feel like 1 example with name swaps
